content.value_statement: SpecDD projects need reviews that respect active contracts and local authority. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through targeted spec resolution and finding-focused review.
actual_capabilities: Guides review of code diffs against active SpecDD contracts.
Defines the bootstrap file read order for SpecDD projects.
Directs agents to resolve target-specific governing spec chains.
Prioritizes concrete findings with file, contract, risk, and fix details.
Requires uncertainty to be reported instead of inventing missing requirements.
limitations: Only applies to projects with a root .specdd/bootstrap.md file.
Does not edit files unless the user explicitly requests changes.
Requires governing specs to exist and be readable in the project.
Does not replace human judgment for underspecified product behavior.

use_cases.title: Review a feature branch
use_cases.description: Compare changed behavior against the active SpecDD contracts before merge.

use_cases.title: Check contract coverage
use_cases.description: Identify whether verification matches the behavioral risk described by governing specs.

use_cases.title: Audit release changes
use_cases.description: Summarize concrete SpecDD violations, open questions, and residual risk for release review.

prompt_templates.title: Basic SpecDD Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Start a simple review of current changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my current changes against the active SpecDD specs. Lead with findings and include residual risk.

prompt_templates.title: Targeted File Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Review a specific area of the project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the changes for the selected files against their governing SpecDD chain. Cite the contract behind each finding.

prompt_templates.title: Verification Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Check whether tests match behavioral risk.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review whether the verification for this change matches the SpecDD risk. Report missing coverage and any underspecified behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Release Gate Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a release-focused SpecDD review. Resolve the relevant spec chain, prioritize violations, and separate findings from open questions.

output_examples.input: Review my feature branch for SpecDD compliance.
output_examples.output: Findings are listed first by severity. Each item names the changed area, violated contract, behavior risk, and smallest likely fix.

output_examples.input: Check whether my tests satisfy the active specs.
output_examples.output: The review identifies covered scenarios, missing verification, and residual risk where the governing specs do not define expected behavior.

output_examples.input: Prepare a pre-merge SpecDD review summary.
output_examples.output: The result separates confirmed violations, open questions, assumptions, and remaining test gaps for a clear merge decision.

best_practices: Use the skill only after confirming the project has a root SpecDD bootstrap file.
Read the narrowest governing specs needed for the current review decision.
Report uncertainty clearly when the active specs do not define expected behavior.
anti_patterns: Do not invent requirements from nearby filenames or implementation conventions.
Do not treat summarized spec text as enough when exact wording is needed.
Do not use this skill to edit files unless the user asks for changes.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews code changes against active SpecDD bootstrap files and governing specs.

faq.question: Does it modify project files?
faq.answer: No. The skill says not to edit files unless the user explicitly asks for changes.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: What projects are in scope?
faq.answer: It is intended for projects that already have a root .specdd/bootstrap.md file.

faq.question: How are findings reported?
faq.answer: Findings should lead the response and include file context, violated contract, risk, and likely fix.

faq.question: What happens when specs are unclear?
faq.answer: The skill directs the agent to call out uncertainty instead of inventing a violation.
